label: A universal cause of being has every perfection it causes in another thing whose being it causes
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred: the cause-of-being possession d0fc96b7 restricted to universal causes of being and distinct effects. If c causes the being of every other being that has being, and c causes x's being and x's being r, with x other than c, then c is in act in r (the frame's InAct, IN_ACT_4). It is the scope of the possession principle (376d6a5a, 2c0b9bd7, d0fc96b7) at the universal source. Open.
